Open source · the engine runs offline on your own machine too
Sign in with your Mides account · Discord or Google

home.title: Time a song in minutes, not hours
home.subtitle: Upload the audio and Overtone finds the BPM, the offset and every red line, and tells you how sure it is about each section.
home.secondary: Sign in to keep your history
home.honest: Overtone does not promise perfect timing. Its benchmark is exact on synthetic tracks; on real ranked maps it is a strong first draft. Confidence is shown so you know where to look.

upload.title: Upload, get red lines
upload.body: BPM, offset, bars and signature changes, ready to paste into [TimingPoints].

confidence.title: Confidence per section
confidence.body: Every section says how much evidence backs it, instead of a number that looks precise.

account.title: With a Mides account
account.body: Keep your analyses, publish timings, and see who else timed the same song.

strip.title: Analysis
strip.caption: An example analysis: four bars of 4/4 at 174 BPM with red lines on bars 1 and 3.

analyze.title: Analyze a song
analyze.subtitle: The audio is analysed and then deleted. Only its fingerprint and the result are kept.
analyze.osuHint: Adds the timing to your own map. Fields you did not ask to change come out byte for byte.
analyze.tooLong: This song is {{minutes}} minutes long; the limit is {{limit}}.
analyze.notReady: Analysis is not open yet. The site is being built: the queue and the analysis worker come next. The server did not read or keep your file.
analyze.drop: Drop the audio here or choose a file
analyze.limitsNote: A Mides account raises both limits and keeps your history.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Overtone uses your Mides account. No new password, nothing to remember.
login.devNote: Development sign-in is on: these buttons sign you in as a test account without Mides.
login.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this server.
login.privacy: Overtone only keeps your public Mides profile: name, avatar and banner. Never your email.
